en: Colorized historic postcard view of a large gabled town hall building fronting a cobbled square. The building has a steep red roof, a stepped or curved gable with a clock, and a small tower or cupola on top. A fountain or statue stands in front of the facade, and a sign reading "Ratskeller" is visible at street level. People are walking in the square in front of the town hall. The sky is lightly clouded and the overall style suggests an early 20th‑century printed postcard.
